snippet.title: Still Wakes the Deep: Siren’s Rest | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Sink below the waves of the North Sea to explore what’s left of the Beira D, and piece together the final moments of the oil rig’s crew. 

But beware - there are things lurking in the depths that even the sea cannot claim.

Still Wakes The Deep: Siren’s Rest, the paid story expansion for the BAFTA award-winning horror game, is OUT NOW on on Steam, Epic Games Store, Xbox via Series X|S and PC, and PlayStation®5 (PS5™), for $12.99/£9.99/€12.99.

Download now: https://store.wearesecretmode.com/
Steam DLC page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3465690 
Follow Secret Mode: https://linktr.ee/wearesecretmode
Find out more: https://stillwakesthedeep.com/
